title: MemScope: Evolving Agent Memory Architectures through Localized Code Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.21170v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent memory architectures define how LLM agents store and reuse experience across tasks, but they are typically fixed after deployment, limiting their adaptability across task types. Recent self-evolving approaches instead adapt these memory architectures using execution feedback, typically represented as evaluation scores or compressed summaries. However, such coarse-grained feedback is insufficient for precise failure localization in current agent systems, where long-horizon task execution involves multiple interacting components. Without a precise failure location, existing approaches lack a clear code-level target for modification, leaving the update scope weakly constrained and often leading to large-scale rewrites of an otherwise capable memory architecture. We propose MemScope, a framework for evidence-grounded, localized evolution of an existing memory architecture. Its tool-using Patch Agent jointly inspects raw execution trace

translated_title: MemScope：通过局部化代码修复实现智能体记忆架构的演化
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆架构定义了LLM智能体如何跨任务存储和复用经验，但它们通常在部署后便固定不变，限制了其在不同任务类型上的适应性。近期的自演化方法转而利用执行反馈来调整这些记忆架构，此类反馈通常表现为评估分数或压缩摘要。然而，在当前智能体系统中，长程任务执行涉及多个相互作用的组件，这种粗粒度反馈不足以实现精确的失败定位。在缺乏精确失败位置的情况下，现有方法缺少明确的代码级修改目标，更新范围约束薄弱，往往导致对原本运行良好的记忆架构进行大规模重写。我们提出MemScope，一个基于证据、对现有记忆架构进行局部化演化的框架。其具备工具使用能力的补丁智能体会联合检查原始执行轨迹……
tldr: MemScope提出了一种基于证据、局部化演化的智能体记忆架构改进框架，通过具备工具使用能力的补丁智能体检查原始执行轨迹来精确定位失败，从而避免对原本有效的记忆架构进行大规模重写。
